title: transformation
content_html:
transformation

In 3 symbols, adding a new concept can remake a whole symbol. In Nerve, Doll is imagined as a means of giving suffering another form. A formal operation and a personal transformation both raise questions about what carries across and what would be impossible to undo. How much can something change and still be recognised as having been the same thing? 3 symbols · Nerve

Reading note. Alchemy and Jung. In Mysterium Coniunctionis, Jung reads alchemical images of separation and conjunction in terms of psychic opposites. That gives one way into the experiment imagined in Nerve. What has to come apart before something can be joined differently, and what kind of joining could Doll make possible? Mysterium Coniunctionis, chapters I and VI
